Configure Tesseract OCR for an English PNG image

```elixir title="Elixir"
input_value = %Xberg.ExtractInput{kind: "uri", mime_type: "image/png", uri: "https://example.com/images/test_hello_world.png"}
result = Xberg.extract_async(input_value, "{\"ocr\":{\"backend\":\"tesseract\",\"enabled\":true,\"language\":[\"eng\"],\"tesseract_config\":{\"psm\":6}}}")
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.results, 0).content)
```
